compare_vehicles.description: Put two to five vehicles side by side on fuel economy, annual fuel cost and tailpipe CO2, and name the winner on each. Feed it the ids from 'List trims' or 'Find a vehicle'.
compare_vehicles.name: compare_vehicles

parameters.description: The vehicles to compare (two to five ids). Accepts a list or a comma-separated string.
parameters.name: vehicle_ids

estimate_fuel_cost.description: Work out what a vehicle costs you to fuel, for your own mileage and city/highway split, at today's published fuel price or one you supply. Returns the yearly and monthly cost, the cost per mile, the fuel used and the CO2 that goes with it. EPA's own figure assumes 15,000 miles a year at 55% city.
estimate_fuel_cost.display_str_template: Estimate the fuel cost of vehicle {0}.
estimate_fuel_cost.name: estimate_fuel_cost

parameters.description: The EPA vehicle record id. Get one from 'List trims', 'Find a vehicle' or any action that returns vehicles.
parameters.name: vehicle_id

parameters.description: How far the vehicle is driven in a year. Defaults to EPA's 15,000.
parameters.name: annual_miles

parameters.description: The share of those miles driven in town. Defaults to EPA's 55%.
parameters.name: city_driving_percent

parameters.description: For a flex-fuel or plug-in vehicle, which of its two fuels to cost. Defaults to the main one.
parameters.name: fuel

options.label: The alternative fuel (E85, electricity, CNG, propane)

parameters.description: Your own price per gallon (or per kWh for an electric vehicle). Leave empty to use the current national price FuelEconomy.gov publishes.
parameters.name: fuel_price

find_vehicle.description: Look up a car's official EPA ratings by year, make and model: city, highway and combined MPG, annual fuel cost, CO2, the EPA scores, and the engine and transmission behind them. Pick a trim for one exact vehicle, or leave it empty to get every trim of the model with its own ratings.
find_vehicle.name: find_vehicle

parameters.description: The vehicle's model year. The list comes straight from EPA's catalogue, which starts at 1984.
parameters.name: year

parameters.description: The manufacturer, from the makes EPA rated that model year.
parameters.name: make

parameters.description: The model, spelled the way EPA spells it: the list holds the exact names ('Civic 4Dr', 'CR-V AWD').
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: The engine, transmission and drive combination. Leave empty to return every trim of this model.
parameters.name: vehicle_id

get_fuel_prices.description: Get the national fuel prices FuelEconomy.gov costs its ratings with: regular, midgrade and premium gasoline, diesel, E85, electricity, compressed natural gas and propane. Gasoline and diesel are updated weekly, the alternative fuels quarterly.
get_fuel_prices.display_str_template: Get current fuel prices from FuelEconomy.gov.
get_fuel_prices.name: get_fuel_prices

get_shared_mpg_summary.description: Get the fuel economy drivers actually report for a vehicle through FuelEconomy.gov's My MPG: the average, the best and worst, the city/highway split and how many drivers it is based on. Says so plainly when nobody has shared any.
get_shared_mpg_summary.display_str_template: Get shared driver MPG for vehicle {0}.
get_shared_mpg_summary.name: get_shared_mpg_summary

parameters.description: The EPA vehicle record id. Get one from 'List trims', 'Find a vehicle' or any action that returns vehicles.
parameters.name: vehicle_id

get_vehicle.description: Get one vehicle's full EPA record by its id: fuel economy, annual fuel cost, CO2, petroleum use, the fuel economy and greenhouse gas scores, interior volume, and the electric or plug-in hybrid figures when the vehicle has them.
get_vehicle.name: get_vehicle

parameters.description: The EPA vehicle record id. Get one from 'List trims', 'Find a vehicle' or any action that returns vehicles.
parameters.name: vehicle_id

get_vehicle_emissions.description: Get a vehicle's emission records: its EPA smog rating out of 10, the emission standard it was certified to, and whether it is a SmartWay vehicle. One record per sales area, because a car certified for California and for the rest of the country is rated separately in each.
get_vehicle_emissions.name: get_vehicle_emissions

parameters.description: The EPA vehicle record id. Get one from 'List trims', 'Find a vehicle' or any action that returns vehicles.
parameters.name: vehicle_id

list_makes.description: List the manufacturers EPA rated for one model year: the first step of the year → make → model → trim walk that leads to a vehicle id.
list_makes.name: list_makes

parameters.description: The vehicle's model year. The list comes straight from EPA's catalogue, which starts at 1984.
parameters.name: year

list_model_years.description: List every model year EPA publishes ratings for, newest first. The catalogue starts at 1984 and runs a year or two ahead of the calendar.
list_model_years.name: list_model_years

list_models.description: List the models a make had in one model year, spelled the way EPA spells them ('Civic 4Dr', 'CR-V AWD'), which is the spelling the other actions need.
list_models.name: list_models

parameters.description: The vehicle's model year. The list comes straight from EPA's catalogue, which starts at 1984.
parameters.name: year

parameters.description: The manufacturer, from the makes EPA rated that model year.
parameters.name: make

list_new_vehicle_tax_credits.description: List the federal clean vehicle tax credits for new electric, plug-in hybrid and fuel cell vehicles: the credit amount, the MSRP cap, whether the vehicle is assembled in North America, and the purchase dates the credit covers. Filter by make, model, model year, technology, or a purchase date.
list_new_vehicle_tax_credits.display_str_template: List new clean vehicle tax credits.
list_new_vehicle_tax_credits.name: list_new_vehicle_tax_credits

parameters.description: Only list vehicles whose make contains this text. Leave empty for every make.
parameters.name: make

parameters.description: Only list vehicles whose model contains this text. Leave empty for every model.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: Only list vehicles of this model year. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: year

parameters.description: Only list these kinds of vehicle. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: technologies

parameters.description: Only list credits that cover a vehicle put into service on this date. Leave empty to ignore dates.
parameters.name: placed_in_service_on

parameters.description: How many records to return, newest model year first. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

list_shared_mpg_makes.description: List the makes drivers have shared fuel economy for. This is a different, older catalogue from the ratings one; it reaches back to makes that no longer exist.
list_shared_mpg_makes.display_str_template: List makes with shared driver MPG.
list_shared_mpg_makes.name: list_shared_mpg_makes

list_shared_mpg_models.description: List a make's models that drivers have shared fuel economy for, ready to feed into 'List shared MPG vehicles'.
list_shared_mpg_models.display_str_template: List {0} models with shared driver MPG.
list_shared_mpg_models.name: list_shared_mpg_models

parameters.description: The manufacturer, from those with shared data.
parameters.name: make

list_shared_mpg_reports.description: List the individual driver reports behind a vehicle's shared fuel economy: each driver's average MPG, their city/highway split, their state and when they last updated it. Highest MPG first, because popular cars have hundreds of them.
list_shared_mpg_reports.display_str_template: List driver MPG reports for vehicle {0}.
list_shared_mpg_reports.name: list_shared_mpg_reports

parameters.description: The EPA vehicle record id. Get one from 'List trims', 'Find a vehicle' or any action that returns vehicles.
parameters.name: vehicle_id

parameters.description: How many reports to return, highest MPG first. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

list_shared_mpg_vehicles.description: List every vehicle record of one model that drivers have shared fuel economy for: one per model year and engine, each a full EPA record whose id feeds the shared MPG summary and reports.
list_shared_mpg_vehicles.display_str_template: List {0} {1} vehicles with shared driver MPG.
list_shared_mpg_vehicles.name: list_shared_mpg_vehicles

parameters.name: make

parameters.description: The model, from those with shared data.
parameters.name: model

list_trims.description: List a model's trims (each engine, transmission and drive combination EPA rated separately) with the vehicle id that every other action takes.

parameters.description: The model, spelled the way EPA spells it: the list holds the exact names ('Civic 4Dr', 'CR-V AWD').
parameters.name: model

list_used_vehicle_tax_credits.description: List the vehicles eligible for the federal pre-owned clean vehicle credit, by make, model, model year and technology. The credit is worth 30% of the sale price up to $4,000, so the list names the qualifying models rather than an amount.
list_used_vehicle_tax_credits.display_str_template: List pre-owned clean vehicle tax credits.
list_used_vehicle_tax_credits.name: list_used_vehicle_tax_credits

description: Look up official EPA fuel economy data from FuelEconomy.gov, the U.S. government's own source: any car from 1984 on with its city, highway and combined MPG, annual fuel cost, CO2 and smog ratings; the fuel prices the ratings are costed at; the mileage real drivers report; and the federal clean vehicle tax credits for new and used EVs, plug-in hybrids and fuel cell vehicles. No account or API key is required.
